thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — ArcOcean pushed back on the bespoke security pack. They want: a 1-day sample of audit-log exports (redacted), KMS rotation timestamps for keys in their namespace, and an export runbook that shows how the file was generated. They quoted EOD Thursday for board review. Also reported intermittent 401s against /v1/admin/exports yesterday.

Jordan (SRE): Can you paste the 401 curl and any x-request-id? Also, was there a deploy around the time? :eyes:

Maya (CS): Ticket https://tickets.redwood/AC-4921 — customer included a curl and response with `x-request-id: rwd-7f3b`. First 401 observed at 2024-11-07T16:12:03Z.

Sam (Dev): I grabbed the trace for rwd-7f3b. Auth proxy rejected the token — looks like a rotate happened and the short-lived token expired during the request. Repro curl they showed:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/exports
```
Server log excerpt:
```
2024-11-07T16:12:03Z ERROR auth_proxy token_expired user=accco customer_id=ac_987
2024-11-07T16:12:04Z WARN export_service export_attempt req_id=rwd-7f3b latency_ms=1320
```
Workaround: have them retry with a fresh token. I'm adding a 60s grace window on rotates so in-flight tokens aren't invalidated mid-request.

Olivia (Security): For the questionnaire we must supply:
- KMS rotation evidence (timestamped rotation entries or attestation)
- HSM attestation or vendor-signed doc (attestation.sig)
- Audit-log sample (last 30 days requested, but we can provide a 1-day sanitized export) plus a manifest outlining retention policy and redaction rules
They also want the exported log schema.

Jordan (SRE): I'll produce a sanitized 1-day export CSV/JSON and a retention manifest. Fields to include (sanitized): timestamp, request_id, customer_id(obfuscated), action, outcome, kms_key_id(obfuscated), node_region. Will not include any PII or raw key material.

Maya (CS): They'll also ask for key IDs used under their account and proof of rotation frequency.

Olivia (Security): Do NOT share key material. Provide obfuscated IDs like `rwd:kms:proj-***` and rotation timestamps. Add a short cover note explaining redaction and chain-of-custody for the export. Reference our KMS rotation policy: https://internal.redwood/kms/policies#rotation

Sam (Dev): I exported a sanitized sample to /tmp/arc_export_20241107.json and uploaded to the secure share: https://files.redwood/s/arc-ocean/presales/arc-export-sample-20241107.json — includes the log lines we used to triage the 401.

Jordan (SRE): Adding the HSM attestation (vendor-signed) link and the manifest. ETA ~4 hours. Note: there was a deploy at 2024-11-07T16:10:00Z that touched auth-proxy; deploy-bot posted in #eng-releases.

deploy-bot: Deploy rwd/auth-proxy @release-2024-11-07-16 succeeded on prod (no automatic rollback). Commit: 9d2c7a

Maya (CS): Can we request an extension to Friday EOD for the full package? They need it for a board packet.

Olivia (Security): Friday EOD OK from compliance. Include a one-page statement of redaction and an ISO27001 control reference table if they ask for mapping.

ArcOcean (Customer): Extension to Friday is fine. We'll retest the export endpoint after your fix.

Sam (Dev): I'll push the rotate-graceguard patch to canary in ~30m and monitor.

Jordan (SRE): I'll attach the sanitized export and retention manifest to ticket https://tickets.redwood/AC-4921 when ready. Also will add the rotation timestamps (obfuscated key IDs) and link to HSM attestation.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll update the customer once artifacts are uploaded and loop back with Olivia for sign-off on the cover note. :heart:

Olivia (Security): One more: include ISO27001 control refs (A.12, A.10 etc) in the cover note mapping to our export/retention controls.

Maya (CS): On it.
